# BigNoteBox

  **By Dukul**
  

  ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1982/494/00-welcome-png.png)

# ℹ️ About

BigNoteBox is a full in-game notepad companion for World of Warcraft.

Create, organize, and manage unlimited notes directly inside the game. Notes are stored account-wide with optional per-character scope, allowing both global planning and character-specific tracking.

It has folders, a search that finds any note from anywhere, sticky notes, notes that show up in the right place, tasks, alarms, rich formatting, history, backups, sharing and much more.

---

## ⬇️ Downloads

You can download BigNoteBox from the official sources below:

- [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/bignotebox)
- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bignotebox)
- [WoWInterface](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info27121-BigNoteBox.html)

## ⚠️ Warning

BigNoteBox is only distributed through the official links above.

If you download it from any other website, it is **not official, not maintained, and may be modified or unsafe**.

---

# 🌍 Runs on

Retail and WoW: Forever, and in beta on Classic Era, TBC Anniversary and Mists of Pandaria Classic. One download for every client.

---

# 📓 Notes & Folders

- As many notes as you like, each with a title and as much text as you want
- Global or per-character scope per note
- Folders: drag notes in, give a folder a color; deleting a folder never deletes its notes
- Pin notes to the top, mark favorites, lock a note against edits
- Sort by creation date, last modified, title or your own drag order
- Duplicate, copy or move notes, alone or several at once in Select mode

---

# 🗂️ Note List & Explorer View

Two ways to see your notes: the Note list beside the open note, or the Explorer view, a grid of icons over the whole window like the file explorer on your computer.

- Pinned, Folders and Notes sections that remember if they are open
- Pick several notes and drag them onto a folder
- Pinned first or Favorites first from the View menu
- Filter by tags, or to notes with tasks

---

# 🔮 Oracle Search

A search bar that finds any note from anywhere in the game, by title, text or tag. Ctrl+Space or `/bnb search`.

- Enter opens the note; Shift as a sticky note, Ctrl in Focus mode, Alt in the Reference Box
- Prefixes narrow it down: player and NPC notes, items, zones, tasks, alarms, this character, today / this week
- Search the Trash or the settings, send a note to chat
- `#tag`, `@who`, `*` favorites, `-word` to leave a word out, `"an exact phrase"`

---

# 🏷️ Tags

- As many tags as you like on a note, the same whatever their case
- Click a tag to show only its notes; the tag tree groups every note by tag
- The Tag Manager renames, colors and deletes tags across all your notes

---

# ✍️ Writing, Templates & Tokens

- Notes save as you type (or with a Save button)
- Undo and redo per note, kept between sessions if you like
- Links to other notes, waypoint links, and links to a Settings page or help topic
- Templates: Blank, Boss, Weekly, Journal, or save any note as your own; share them as a code
- Note tokens fill themselves in: `{{date}}`, `{{zone}}`, `{{target}}`, `{{coords}}`, `{{ilvl}}`, `{{item:6948}}` and your own
- Each note has its own icon, icon frame, border, background and font

---

# 📔 Rich Notes

A rich note is a small page, with a live preview beside the text. The tags are compatible with Total RP 3.

- Headings and paragraphs, left, centered or right
- Colored text with a color picker
- Game icons, game art (atlas) and your own pictures
- Clickable links; item and spell links show their tooltips
- Shows as a page on sticky notes too

---

# ⚡ Quick Notes & Note Capture

- F7 makes a new note at once, in the main window or as a sticky note
- Quest, gossip, book and letter windows get a note button: one click keeps their text
- Dialogue UI and Immersion get the same button

---

# 🎯 Focus Mode

- Write in full screen with the game interface hidden
- The camera slowly circles your character (or not)
- A rich note gets its preview beside the text
- Esc brings everything back as it was

---

# 📌 Sticky Notes

- Pin any note to your screen; up to 50 at once (20 by default)
- Each sticky has its own font, size, color, background and border
- A note with tasks can show its tasks, ticked right on the sticky
- Stickies can stay on the Esc menu screen instead of the game screen
- Ctrl+H shows or hides every sticky, Ctrl+J brings them to the front

---

# 🔔 Situations & Toasts

A note shows up by itself where it matters, as a toast or a sticky note.

- A zone, sub-zone, instance or instance type (dungeon, raid, delve, battleground)
- A player, an NPC or a guild
- A window: vendor, bank, mailbox, auction house or trainer
- Being rested, in an inn or in a city
- When it starts, ends or both; every time, once a session, a day, a reset or only once
- A situation can place waypoints
- Toasts: choose which show, where, how they look and how long they stay

---

# ✅ Tasks

- Checklists with sub-tasks inside any note
- Untick themselves at the daily or weekly reset, the whole list or one task at a time
- Tick them on a sticky note
- One button shows only notes with tasks

---

# ⏰ Alarms

- Ring at a real-world time, an in-game time, or the daily or weekly reset
- Once, or on the days you choose
- The note pops up with a sound; snooze or dismiss
- The alarm list shows every alarm

---

# 🗃️ Reference Box

- Items, spells, quests and links attached to a note, beside the editor
- Drag them in, or Shift-click a link while it is open
- A note about a player keeps their gear, with a model viewer and a transmog view
- Ctrl-click a gear card to open the dressing room

---

# 👤 Player & NPC Notes

- A note about a player from the Inspect window or their right-click menu, about an NPC with F6
- Portrait and details filled in, a player's gear in the Reference Box
- tl;dr: one short line (like KOS) that shows in their tooltip

---

# 🕰️ History, Undo & 🗑️ Trash

History and kept undo live in the `BigNoteBox_History` addon, which comes with BigNoteBox.

- A version of each note is saved when you log out or reload
- Compare two versions side by side and bring an old one back
- Restore points by hand before a big change
- Rescue a note that went missing without being deleted
- Deleted notes wait in the Trash for 30 days (you choose how long)

---

# 💾 Backup, Import & 🔄 Migration

- Full backup: notes, templates, tokens, tag colors and every settings profile, as JSON
- Settings backup, and a Selective backup in JSON or Markdown
- Import takes backups, shared notes, template codes and profile codes
- Export a note as HTML in three styles
- Move your notes over from OneWoW Notes, Noteworthy II, Take A Note, Yet Another Notepad, Notepad, Notes, TinyPad, PurpleNotes, SimpleNote, Quick Notes, MyNotepad and AmmeNotepad: see them before they come in, nothing is removed from the other addon

---

# 🤝 Sharing

- Share a note with what goes with it: tags, tasks, Reference Box, look, situation, player or NPC data
- Send it straight to another BigNoteBox user, or as a share code
- Send to Chat posts the note's text in a chat channel, line by line

---

# 🔗 BigChatBox

BigNoteBox works on its own. With BigChatBox installed you can also send a note to chat through it and capture chat into a note.

---

# 🎨 Look & Feel

- Blizzard's own window look by default, or Skin mode in 14 colors (OLED and OLED Flat among them) with a brightness slider
- Bundled fonts, OpenDyslexic among them, plus every LibSharedMedia font you have
- Accessibility: turn off or slow down the sticky note animation

---

# 🧩 Modules & Profiles

- Switch whole parts on or off; Minimal, Full and Custom switch many at once
- Your notes keep everything, so switching a module back on brings it all back
- Settings profiles per character, shared as a code

---

# ❓ Help, ⌨️ Keys & Commands

The help book has every help topic in chapters, with a search: the Help button at the top of the main window, or `/bnb help`.

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Ctrl+N | Open or close BigNoteBox |
| F8 / F7 / F6 | New note / quick note / note from your target |
| Ctrl+Space | Oracle search |
| Ctrl+H / Ctrl+J | Hide or show stickies / stickies to the front |

Commands: `/bnb`, `/bnb new`, `/bnb search <text>`, `/bnb config`, `/bnb whatsnew`, `/bnb features`, `/bnb help`, `/bnb commands`.

---

# 🚨 Danger Zone

Reset the profile in use or every setting, clear the trash or the history, reset sticky layouts, delete all notes, factory reset, re-run the setup wizard. Take a backup first.

---

# 🛠️ Developer Tools

Working on BigNoteBox itself? The developer tools are a separate addon, `BigNoteBox_Dev`, downloadable from each GitHub release. You do not need it to use BigNoteBox. See [DEVTOOL.md](https://github.com/DukulWoW/BigNoteBox/blob/main/DEVTOOL.md).

---

# 📜 License

The code is licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3](https://github.com/DukulWoW/BigNoteBox/blob/main/LICENSE). The BigNoteBox and BigChatBox logos and the addon icon are All Rights Reserved, and the rest of the art is World of Warcraft art belonging to Blizzard Entertainment: see [LICENSE-ASSETS](https://github.com/DukulWoW/BigNoteBox/blob/main/LICENSE-ASSETS). Bundled libraries and fonts keep their own licenses. Releases up to v1.22.x were MIT licensed.

# BigNoteBox v2.1.1

## All versions

### Fixed
- A Lua error that repeated in dungeons and raids (Ragefire Chasm on WoW Forever) while a note had a situation: the game now hides some names there, and BigNoteBox skips them.

# BigNoteBox v2.1.0

## All versions

### New

#### Languages and spelling

- German translation: BigNoteBox speaks Deutsch, the Help book and Features tab included. It follows a German game client, or pick it in Settings > General > Language.
- Spelling in French and German: install the new BigNoteBox Spelling Pack and pick the language in Settings > Modules > Spelling.
- German spelling understands compound words (Gildenbank, Questgeber), checks every noun with its capital, and a long misspelled word gets suggestions for the broken part (Drachenschuppenrüstung). Settings > Modules > Spelling can limit it to the compounds the German dictionary allows.
- Each note can have its own spelling language: right-click a marked word, then Language, or use the new language button on the formatting toolbar. A note checked in another language than your game's shows that language's shield next to its title.

#### Notes

- Move your notes over from SimpleNotepad and Siggis Notepad (Siggis Notepad's trashed notes go to the Trash).
- Vendor notes: a new button on the vendor window saves everything the vendor sells (with prices and limited stock) in its NPC note and Reference Box, tagged Vendor. Click again on a later visit to update the list.

### Change

#### Spelling

- Spelling page: pick the language by clicking its flag (the dropdown is gone); every installed dictionary's flag is in color.
- A note's hover tooltip shows one language line for each script in it (Korean, Chinese, Russian...).

#### Notes and editing

- Quest notes: the quest is a link heading at the top (right-click it to copy the Wowhead address), Objectives and Rewards get their own headings and dividers. Every rich capture note (quests, books, letters, dialogue) ends on a Notes part for your own words. From Dialogue UI too: its quest and rewards become game links with their icons, money shows as coins and XP with its icon.
- Right-click a quest, item, spell or currency link in a note: Copy Wowhead URL.
- Undo: the Forced interval slider now goes down to 0.5 seconds.

#### Settings

- Settings > Backup: a line under the import box says that a large backup can make the game seem frozen for a moment.
- Settings > Modules > Tags: the tag tree settings and where the Tag Manager opens have their own page now (they were on the Notes tab).
- Buttons fit their labels in every language: a long label gets a little smaller, and if it still does not fit it ends in ... with the whole text on hover.

### Fixed

- Rich notes: drop shadows and the note's own font (Note Settings > Appearance) now show in the rich view. A sticky's rich view follows its Sticky settings font and outline, like a plain sticky.

# BigNoteBox v2.0.0

## All versions

### New

#### Explorer view

- Explorer view: your notes as a grid of icons over the whole window, like a file explorer, with its own toolbar, multi-select, drag and drop, and a status bar. Turn it on or off in Settings > Modules > Explorer view.
- Explorer view: Small, Medium and Large tiles, List, Details (sortable columns) and Flat, in the View menu.
- Explorer view: View menu options to put pinned notes first without sections, or favorites first.
- Explorer view: New folder with selection, and Remember the open note (Settings > Modules > Explorer view)
- Explorer view: with the Reference Box's auto-open on, clicking a note opens its Reference Box when it has attachments or tasks.

#### Folders

- Folders: sort your notes into folders, with a color each, in the note list and the explorer. Folders come along in backups. Settings > Modules > Folders.

#### Help book and patch notes

- The help book: every help topic in one book, with chapters, a search and a Glossary. Open it with the new Help button on the top bar or /bnb help.
- Right-click a button on the formatting or rich toolbar to open its help topic.
- The help book has a Features tab (what BigNoteBox can do, A-Z), which replaces the old Features window.
- Patch notes: every release back to v1.6.9 in the help book's Patch notes tab. After an update a toast opens the new release there, and no pinned patch note is added to your note list any more.

#### Spelling and text shortcuts

- Spelling: red wavy lines under misspelled words, English (US) or English (UK), as you type or with the Check spelling button. Settings > Modules > Spelling.
- Spelling: right-click a marked word for suggestions, Add to dictionary or Ignore, and a Correct spelling window that goes through them one by one.
- Spelling: repeated words (the the) are marked, with options to ignore UPPERCASE words and words with numbers.
- Spelling works in Focus mode and sticky notes too.
- Key bindings: Check spelling (F9) and Correct spelling (F10)
- Text shortcuts: type brb and it becomes "be right back". Make your own in Settings > Modules > Spelling, with an "Only with !" option.

#### Writing notes

- Find and replace in a note: Ctrl+F or the new button on the formatting toolbar, in the editor and Focus mode.
- Rich notes: underline and strikethrough, two new buttons on the rich toolbar.
- Rich notes: dividers, a new button on the rich toolbar.
- Rich notes: {code}...{/code} shows text exactly as typed, tags and all.
- Links to BigNoteBox itself: the link button's new BigNoteBox tab links a note to a Settings page or window.
- An open note has two new buttons: Note settings on the formatting toolbar, and Situation on the action bar.
- Note right-click menu: Favorite, Pin, Lock, Rename and Delete are a row of icons at the bottom. Rename is new.
- Sort menus: Reset sort, and Make this the default.

#### Note Capture, player and NPC notes

- Note Capture: quest, book and dialogue notes can be rich notes, one setting per kind in Settings > Modules > Note Capture.
- Note Capture: quest notes show when you accepted or turned in the quest, its level and kind, a Wowhead address and a waypoint link.
- Note Capture: the NPC's name in a quest or dialogue note links to that NPC's own note.
- Note Capture: captured notes get the zone as a tag, and optionally the subzone.
- What an NPC says now goes into that NPC's own note instead of a note of its own.
- Dialogue UI: a BigNoteBox button beside its Copy Text button.
- Player and NPC notes made from a target or inspect get dividers between their sections.
- NPC notes are round like player notes, with an Elite or Rare frame (Retail and Forever)

#### Other languages in notes

- Notes with Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Cyrillic or Greek text use a font that can show them, and get a language shield on the title row and tooltip.

#### Accessibility

- Settings > Modules > Accessibility: a new page, starting with Motion settings for the sticky note animation.
- Smooth scrolling everywhere. Turn it off or change its speed under Accessibility > Motion.

### Change

#### Look and windows

- BigNoteBox has a new icon and is listed under Notes & Organization in the game's AddOns list.
- BigNoteBox windows and sticky notes come to the front when clicked, like normal windows.
- The main window and toasts get better default positions and sizes on ultrawide screens.
- Search boxes have a round X to clear them.
- Hiding and showing sticky notes is animated.
- The minimap button's situation count is a big green number in the middle of the icon.
- Setup wizard: two fewer questions on the Notes & behavior page.

#### Notes and editing

- Focus mode: a status bar at the bottom, more room for the note, and a two-row toolbar with the font picker.
- Player notes have a round icon, matching the live portrait shown while that player is targeted.
- The note list's sort now sorts your pinned notes too.
- Collapsing the note list clears the search and filters.
- Export from a note's right-click menu goes straight to the copy popup.
- Deleting several notes at once leaves locked notes alone.
- Importing a backup: a settings profile with a name you already have can replace yours or be added as a copy.

#### Reference Box and Note Capture

- Reference Box: the model viewer says "Loading..." while an NPC model loads.
- Immersion: the Note Capture button sits on the corner of Immersion's text box, so it no longer covers the text.

#### Translation

- Simplified Chinese: everything new in 2.0 is translated.

### Fixed

- Sticky notes: text color, font, size, outline, shadow and alignment changes show again.
- Changing the font in Settings no longer resets every open sticky's own font.
- Sticky notes: the Line height setting works.
- Note Settings: font changes on a rich note show at once.
- The rich note preview wraps its text when you resize it.
- Tasks: the row's buttons no longer cover the task you are editing.
- Settings no longer goes blank after Focus mode.
- Search bar: the tag suggestions have a background.
- Settings profiles: pressing Enter in the name and Import boxes works.
- OLED Flat skin: grayed-out toolbar buttons are visible again.

## Retail only

### Fixed

- A crash to desktop when an NPC note's model was loading in the Reference Box.

## WoW Forever only

### Change

- Ready for the WoW: Forever launch: the beta notice is gone, and Report a bug sits beside the Settings window.

## Classic only

### Fixed

- Cursors that were wrong or drew as a black square.

# BigNoteBox v1.30.0

## All versions

### New
- Settings profiles: Settings > Advanced starts with Profiles. Keep different settings and window layouts for different characters (a bank alt, a raider): clone the one you use or start a blank one with the setup wizard, rename, delete, and export / import a profile as a code to share. Every character starts on Default; the profile you pick is the one it loads with. Notes are shared by every profile, and the full JSON backup keeps every profile too (importing it adds them; one whose name you already have, such as Default, comes in as "Default (1)"). Danger Zone can reset just the profile in use, or all settings and profiles.

### Change
- Right-click menus: the menu of an item or spell link, and of a Reference Box entry, shows its icon beside the name; a web link's menu leaves out https:// and www. so more of the address shows. The menu of a link to another note has Open as sticky note, Share note, Copy note to clipboard and Copy / Move to...
- Right-click menus: an item, spell or other game link in the note you are editing (also in View and Focus mode) has Add to Reference Box. A web link's menu shows a link symbol in front of the address.
- Reference Box: Insert at text cursor reads Insert at bottom of note until you click into the note's text, and puts the link on a new line at the end instead of being greyed out.
- Focus mode: link menus work there. Share note, Send to Chat, Copy / Move and the copy box open over Focus mode, Add to Reference Box opens the box beside it, and rows that need a game window (item card, dressing room, chat line, map) close Focus mode first. Focus mode's bottom bar has the Reference Box and Add task buttons too.
- Settings > Backup: three buttons, Full backup (notes, templates, tokens, tag colours and settings profiles), Settings backup (profiles only) and Selective backup (pick JSON or Markdown and which notes and parts go in). Each copies straight away with Ctrl+C. Importing a backup that holds more than notes shows what is in it, so you can untick parts.
- Back up first, offered before an import or a migration, shows the copy popup: Ctrl+C copies your notes and the import goes on, Esc stops it.
- Simplified Chinese: settings profiles, the new Backup page and the new right-click menu lines are translated.

### Fixed
- Reference Box: the right-click menu no longer opens under the entry's tooltip.
- Tags: a tag that starts with a Chinese (or other non-Latin) letter is no longer broken when it is added, and tags already broken this way are repaired. A backup of notes with such a tag no longer comes up empty.

# BigNoteBox v1.29.0

## All versions

### New
- Right-click a link in a note, rich or normal, for a menu: Send to chat, Show and Try on for items; Set waypoint, Show on map, Send to chat and Copy /way for waypoints; Open note and Share to chat for links to other notes; Send to chat and Copy link for web links.
- The right-click menu in the note text now holds the note token groups, the same as the toolbar's token button, in place of the old insert rows; new token {{datetime}} for the date and time together.
- Links to other notes show in that note's title colour, and follow it when it changes.

### Change
- Note tokens in a normal note become their value as you type or pick them (your gold, an item's link, your own tokens); rich notes keep them live and filled each time they are shown. A rich note made normal gets the values of that moment.
- Clicking an item or other game link in a normal note works as in a rich note (the card, Ctrl+click to try it on); Shift+click sends a link to chat in both, opening the chat line if it is closed.
- Send to chat goes straight into BigChatBox's chat line when BigChatBox is on.
- Reference Box right-click menus show the entry's name at the top and an icon on every row.
- The note token lists call their groups Here and now and Character, and their tooltips say how tokens fill in rich and normal notes.
- The note toolbar's overflow menu uses short names (Restore point, History, Alarm, Copy / Move, Share, Show on map); the longer text is in the tooltip.
- Settings > Backup shows the Rescue section only while there are notes to rescue, at the top of the page, so the page no longer needs a scrollbar.
- Simplified Chinese: everything added since the last translation is translated (templates, tags, note tokens, links, Rescue and more).

### Fixed
- Up and Down move through the token list again in notes, Focus mode, sticky editing and the tl;dr boxes.
- Pressing Enter at the bottom of a note scrolls the note along, so the line you are typing stays in view.
- Clicking the note title to rename it frames only the title, not the tl;dr line above it.
